title: Coupled roll-spiral mode prohibited (conservative: Category A phases other than CO, GA): Level 3, Category A (Category A phases other than CO, GA)

ruleset.name: MIL-F-8785C
ruleset.basis: Class IV; bare airframe; the classical modes of the linear model are the equivalent system (3.1.12)

source.extract_quote: "such as CO and GA", a coupled roll-spiral mode in response to pilot roll commands is not allowed
source.transcribed_by: agent fq (M6, review R2 fixes 2026-10-05) from the MIL-F-8785C page images and docs/MIL8785C_EXTRACT.md
source.interpretation: 3.3.1.4 (p.23): "For Flight Phases which involve more than gentle maneuvering, such as CO and GA, the airplane characteristics shall not exhibit a coupled roll-spiral mode"; the permission with zeta_RS omega_nRS minima is given to Categories B and C only. Conservative reading: the prohibition also applies to the other Category A phases (precision tracking or rapid maneuvering). Review R2 M2.
